title: 换脚接短伸手
description: 彩铅记录低位宽点换脚之后的小幅伸手，手脚关系清楚。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: An original colored-pencil illustration shows a fictional adult completing a careful foot swap on a wide low foothold before a short reach. Both hands stay on generous orange holds, the incoming shoe settles beside the supporting shoe, and the torso turns slightly toward the next nearby jug. The route traverses horizontally across a nearly vertical wall, keeping all action close to thick continuous crash mats. Use a medium-wide side-oblique view showing the entire opaque-clothed adult and clear landing space. Warm paper grain, indigo pencil shadows, and muted teal clothing establish a calm original scene. Maintain credible adult anatomy. No jumping, text, brands, falling, or high exposure.
